descriptionChirho: Adverb of place indicating a downward direction or a lower position. Greek κάτω covers the spatial range from directional motion downward to static position beneath. Spanish 'abajo, de abajo, menos' (below, from below, under/less than); Hindi नीचे / नीचे के (below, lower, underneath); Arabic أَسفَل / ما دُون (lower, beneath, under); Korean 아래로 / 아래에서 (downward, from below); Swahili chini (below, down, under). S70556 covers the more frequent directional and locative uses ('cast down,' 'from below,' 'those below'), while S70557 is the comparative-threshold use ('under two years old' in Matt 2:16), but both express the same fundamental spatial concept of lower position along a vertical axis.
